title: KEEPSAKE — Commemorative silver charms for two interchangeable hosts, 24 deliverables

config.text:
# KEEPSAKE — client facts

## Collection
- Name: KEEPSAKE.
- Charm designs: exactly three, C1, C2 and C3.
- Host chains: exactly two, necklace N and bracelet B.
- Audience: adults incorporating personal memories into everyday jewellery and adding charms over time.
- Existing identity: circular silver connector K with the gate placement shown in keepsake-connector.png.
- Shared form language: three related, individually distinguishable charm silhouettes.
- Open design variables: charm bodies, relief, recessed engraving, lettering style, spacing, position, edge treatment, chain links and clasp styling.

## Inscription records
| charm_id | line_1 | line_2 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| C1 | FIRST LIGHT | 08.06.2019 |
| C2 | MIRA + NOAH | 14.09.2022 |
| C3 | HOMEWARD | 03.04.2025 |

- Record file: 03-inscriptions.md.
- Inscription location: both lines together on the charm’s outward decorated face.
- Letter case: uppercase.
- Fixed characters: recorded letters, spaces, plus sign and date punctuation.
- First-line layout: wrapping permitted.
- Date layout: one readable line.
- Detail-view content: actual engraving visible on the designed silver face.

## K/R/L interface
| Component | Property | Value |
| --- | --- | --- |
| K | Closed outer diameter | 6.0 mm |
| K | Circular wire diameter | 1.0 mm |
| K | Open-gate clear gap | 2.5 mm |
| R | Outer diameter | 4.0 mm |
| R | Wire diameter | 1.0 mm |
| R | Clear bore | 2.0 mm |
| L | Outer diameter | 4.0 mm |
| L | Clear bore | 2.0 mm |
| L | Axial thickness | 1.0 mm |

- Geometry source: attachment-interfaces.png; undecorated local parts and nominal dimensions.
- K: opening connector, one per attached charm.
- R: closed receiving ring belonging to the host.
- L: integral eye belonging to the charm.
- Attachment path: one K through one charm L and one host R.
- Exchange action: K opens; R and L remain closed and retain their shapes.
- Empty station: R alone.
- Compatibility: each R1, R2 or R3 station on N or B accepts any one of C1, C2 or C3 through K.
- L continuation in the interface image: open charm-body design region.
- Mechanism development: concept-level gate access and opening sequence; hinge and lock internals remain design variables.

## Scale and surfaces
| Item | Property | Value |
| --- | --- | --- |
| C1, C2, C3 | Maximum complete height × width × depth, including L | 22 × 18 × 3 mm |
| N | Closed chain path including clasp, excluding hanging charms | 460 mm |
| B | Closed chain path including clasp, excluding hanging charms | 190 mm |
| N | Receiving stations | 3 |
| B | Receiving stations | 3 |
| Bracelet wearing context | Nominal adult wrist circumference | 170 mm |

- Selected charm dimensions: individual height, width and depth recorded for C1, C2 and C3.
- Station order: R1–R2–R3 in each labelled flat front presentation.
- Station spacing and link construction: collection design choices recorded in the design sheets and, where supplied, the materials and craft sheet.
- Flexible-chain posing: persistent station identities; reverse projection may reverse their apparent order.
- Material throughout charms, hosts, clasps and visible K/R/L parts: 925 silver.
- Surface palette: polished, satin/brushed and oxidized silver, singly or in combination.
- Dark engraving option: oxidized silver recesses.
- Surface allocation: consistent across the collection and its repeated views.
- Repeated imagery: views of the same components and reuse of source artwork in the presentation.

## Combination records
| combination_id | host | R1 | R2 | R3 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| WN1 | N | C1 | C2 | empty |
| WN2 | N | empty | C3 | empty |
| WN3 | N | C1 | empty | C3 |
| WN4 | N | C1 | C2 | C3 |
| WB1 | B | C2 | empty | C3 |
| WB2 | B | empty | C1 | empty |
| WB3 | B | C1 | empty | C2 |
| WB4 | B | C1 | C2 | C3 |

- Record file: 04-combinations.md.
- Moving charm identity: its silhouette, inscription, finish and single K travel together.

## Wearing records
| Code | Placement | Clothing and pose | Host length |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| WN1 | Adult upper chest | Open neckline | N 460 mm |
| WN2 | Adult upper chest | Over a fine knit top | N 460 mm |
| WB1 | Adult left wrist, nominal circumference 170 mm | Relaxed hand and shirt cuff | B 190 mm |
| WB2 | Adult left wrist, nominal circumference 170 mm | Gently flexed wrist and short sleeves | B 190 mm |

- WN3, WN4, WB3 and WB4: flat assembly variations.
- Wearing-board labels: W code, host length and occupied and empty station assignments.
- Wearing-board framing: complete jewellery configuration with enough body and clothing to establish placement and scale.
- Detail inset: connection and actual engraving on the same jewellery.
- Open styling variables: adult appearance, clothing colours and camera position.
- Video record: WB1, 10 seconds, gentle wrist rotation.

## Printed identity
- Exact name: KEEPSAKE.
- Name locations: every final design sheet, assembly board and wearing board; video title and presentation cover where supplied.
- Video configuration label: WB1.

## Input ownership
- Original documents and native interface diagram: author-owned inputs, redistribution permitted.

steps.userMessage:
KEEPSAKE | Commemorative silver charms for two interchangeable hosts

We are extending KEEPSAKE around an existing silver connector: three distinct charms, C1, C2 and C3, moving between necklace N and bracelet B. Adults should be able to add a memory while keeping the pieces they already wear. Develop three related silhouettes, each within 22 × 18 × 3 mm including its integral eye, and state each charm’s chosen height, width and depth. N measures 460 mm and B measures 190 mm along the closed chain path, including the clasp and excluding hanging charms. Each host has three receiving stations, R1–R2–R3 in its labelled flat front view; choose and record their spacing and the chain construction. The charms, chains, clasps and visible connectors are 925 silver, with a consistent allocation of polished, satin/brushed or oxidized silver surfaces. Engrave both inscription lines on each charm’s outward decorated face: C1 carries "FIRST LIGHT" above 08.06.2019; C2 carries "MIRA + NOAH" above 14.09.2022; C3 carries "HOMEWARD" above 03.04.2025. The first line may wrap; each date remains a single readable line.

The supplied K/R/L interface is fixed. K has a closed outer diameter of 6.0 mm, circular wire diameter of 1.0 mm and open-gate clear gap of 2.5 mm. The closed host ring R has an outer diameter of 4.0 mm, wire diameter of 1.0 mm and clear bore of 2.0 mm. Each integral charm eye L has an outer diameter of 4.0 mm, clear bore of 2.0 mm and axial thickness of 1.0 mm. One K passes through one L and one host R for each attached charm; opening K releases that charm while R and L remain closed. An empty station consists of its R alone. Retain the existing connector’s recognisable circular form and gate placement. Use the eight recorded combinations, preserving station identities as the chains move. Bracelet wearing views use a nominal 170 mm adult left wrist. Print "KEEPSAKE" on every final design sheet, assembly board and wearing board, and on the video title and presentation cover where supplied.

Audience: our collection lead and silver workshop, choosing the range and preparing the development brief for adults building a personal collection over time.

Inputs (attached): 01-client-facts.en.md contains the collection, material, interface and wearing facts. 02-delivery-catalog.en.md lists each deliverable’s proportion, format and stage. 03-inscriptions.md contains the three engraving records. 04-combinations.md contains the eight station assignments. attachment-interfaces.png is the constraint image defining the undecorated K/R/L geometry. keepsake-connector.png is the identity image recording the existing circular connector and its gate placement. wrist-layering-reference.png is the atmosphere reference for adult wrist framing and neutral clothing layers.

Deliverables:
1. One one-page materials and craft sheet recording 925 silver, finish allocation, the K/R/L dimensions, chosen C1–C3 dimensions, N and B lengths, station spacing, chain construction and engraving treatment
2. Three charm design sheets, one each for C1, C2 and C3, with front, reverse and side views, readable engraving, dimensions and finish annotations
3. One host-chain design sheet showing N and B in labelled flat front views, their clasps, chain construction, lengths and three station positions
4. Five detail sheets: closed and open K/R/L connection and gate access; the three engraved silver faces and surface treatment; N station spacing and ring attachment; B station spacing and ring attachment; and sections through the integral L eyes of C1, C2 and C3
5. Eight flat assembly boards, one per configuration in R1–R2–R3 order: WN1 N C1/C2/empty; WN2 N empty/C3/empty; WN3 N C1/empty/C3; WN4 N C1/C2/C3; WB1 B C2/empty/C3; WB2 B empty/C1/empty; WB3 B C1/empty/C2; WB4 B C1/C2/C3
6. Four wearing boards: WN1 at an adult’s open neckline; WN2 over an adult’s fine knit top; WB1 on an adult left wrist with a relaxed hand and shirt cuff; and WB2 on an adult left wrist gently flexed in short sleeves, each with a readable connection and engraving inset
7. One 10-second WB1 wearing video showing the complete bracelet configuration during a gentle wrist rotation
8. One collection presentation of at least 12 pages, reusing the materials and craft sheet, charm and host designs, five details, eight assemblies and four wearing boards

Acceptance:
- The materials and craft sheet precedes the design sheets and records 925 silver, the complete fixed K/R/L dimensions and the N 460 mm and B 190 mm lengths; the connection detail repeats those interface dimensions, the host-chain sheet repeats both lengths, and the presentation repeats all three sets of facts.
- The three charm design sheets and engraving detail show C1 FIRST LIGHT / 08.06.2019, C2 MIRA + NOAH / 14.09.2022 and C3 HOMEWARD / 03.04.2025 engraved on their respective decorated faces, preserving every letter, space, plus sign and date punctuation; the design sheets state dimensions within 22 × 18 × 3 mm and carry the craft sheet’s finish allocation.
- The five detail sheets repeat the host-chain sheet’s station spacing and construction and the fixed L dimensions of 4.0 mm outer diameter, 2.0 mm bore and 1.0 mm axial thickness where applicable; the connection detail and all eight assembly boards use one K per occupied station and R alone at empty stations, with the exact assignments listed for WN1–WN4 and WB1–WB4.
- The four wearing boards label their W code, host length and all three station assignments and preserve the matching assembly configurations; WN1 and WN2 retain N at 460 mm, while WB1 and WB2 retain B at 190 mm on the nominal 170 mm left wrist in their specified clothing and hand positions.
- The 10-second WB1 video preserves C2 at R1, R2 empty and C3 at R3 on B throughout the wrist rotation; its title prints KEEPSAKE and WB1.
- The presentation has at least 12 pages and reuses all three charm designs, both hosts, five details, eight assembly boards and four wearing boards; its cover and every final design sheet, assembly board and wearing board print KEEPSAKE.

Please clearly mark which version you consider the final deliverable. If nothing is marked, the last exported version counts.
